# Original single-Covenant player matrix

The all-four combination separately passes seventeen actual player inputs and
fresh frozen replay; see [combination evidence](true-final-boss-covenant-combinations.md).

All four original single definitions now pass the actual separate Advisor
assembly, complete native losses and independent fresh-process frozen replay.
The eight `full-battle-player-true-final-boss-covenant{00,01,04,08}-{search,replay}.mt2f`
archives contain 39 source inputs and the same 39 replay inputs. Every input,
root, successor, complete forecast, terminal state and RNG matches. All eight
processes exit normally with settled effects, protected files unchanged and
zero capture/mismatch/unsupported/pending counters.

| Covenant | Inputs (plays/EndTurns) | Source publications/pure captures | Replay pure captures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 00 | 6 (1/5) | 8/94 | 19 |
| 01 | 17 (12/5) | 19/257 | 59 |
| 04 | 10 (5/5) | 12/145 | 35 |
| 08 | 6 (1/5) | 8/101 | 19 |

Source UI rendering, pointer routing, drag/clamp, pause/resume,
hide/cancel/show and refresh pass. Every player capture has zero purity
failures. All replay inputs have zero search nodes and publications. Source
advice uses three turns, a 3,000-ms soft search budget and tactical candidates;
this is neither a hard response deadline nor a winning search configuration.

Each source below uses prefix `full-battle-units-spells-and-junk-`:

| 08 | `20261023-082738-8e677e91` | `20261023-083042-a787c257` |

Every route explicitly jumps to unchanged `Level9TrueFinalBoss_V2`, activates
one entire original Covenant after run startup and keeps the original starting
deck/Pyre80. No encounter, health, phase or wave substitution occurs. Native
stat previews preserve their frame and all sixteen RNG streams. Five authored
boss definitions and thirteen distinct ordinary wave assets/26 definitions
retain raw bases and exact Covenant origins; missing/spoofed origins and
off-by-one boss adjustments are rejected. Source/replay additionally check
each entire original Covenant identity and its effect list.

The production gate now accepts exactly these four single original definitions
and the existing no-Covenant case. Rank-one wave capture uses this calibrated
TFB path; other rank-one encounters keep their existing guard. Covenant01
startup purge/add-card operations are not re-executed in combat. The player
captures the resulting current deck and only reads native stat previews;
the controlled activation and route jump remain exclusive to the probe.

These losses do not prove natural high-rank campaign startup, natural story
unlock, combined Covenants, uncalibrated encounters/decks or Covenant terminal/
relentless extensions. See [birth and full-turn evidence](true-final-boss-covenant-birth.md)
and [Covenant04 details](player-true-final-boss-covenant04.md).

Focused acceptance:

```powershell
./scripts/Check-PlayerAdvisor.ps1 -Case TrueFinalBossCovenant00,TrueFinalBossCovenant01,TrueFinalBossCovenant04,TrueFinalBossCovenant08 -SkipBuild
```

Each case was checked directly against its two native archives;
no full regression or Mac build was performed.
